CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YOGESH KHANNA
This petition is filed for quashing of FIR No.82/2015 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Nanakpura, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. The marriage between the petitioner No.1 and complainant/ respondent No.2 was solemnized on 21.02.2007 according to Hindu rites and ceremonies.
However, due to marital discord a complaint was filed by respondent no.2 before CAW Cell on 27.10.2013, which culminated into present FIR on 29.07.2015.
However, during the pendency of proceedings, the couple settled the matter and has obtained divorce by mutual consent on 04.12.2017.

3. The complainant/respondent No.2 has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer, states the matter has been settled with the petitioners and no claim is left of whatsoever nature including the permanent alimony, maintenance (present, past and future) stridhan etc. against the petitioners and she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
The learned ASC for the State has also no objection, if this petition is allowed.
The affidavits of parties are on record.
4. Considering the above settlement between the parties, there is no impediment in quashing of the FIR as complainant has settled all the disputes.

In view of the above, there is no use to continue with Krishna Kumar @ Kuashal vs The Stae And Anr on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199459273/
1 the proceedings against petitioners as it would never entail in conviction of petitioners.
